shared_elements: winged element spread horizontally across the upper field
low-relief carving on a vertical slab
justification: Both depict profile human figures in low relief on an upright slab beneath or beside outspread wings, and both include a circular disc motif and staff-like held objects, which is a modestly specific correspondence. But A is a single colossal winged figure filling the whole field with an upraised arm and no text, while B is a compact stela divided into registers: a winged disc lunette, a small row of confronted worshipper figures, and many lines of script filling the lower half — a wholly different compositional scheme and scale of figure.
